text: Sparse and dense retrieval baselines need identical evaluation splits to be comparable.
BM25 remains a strong lexical baseline for passage ranking on many collections.
Dense retrieval encodes queries and passages with a dual encoder and scores them by dot product.
Evaluation harnesses should record seeds, data digests, and ranker configuration.
Hard negatives mined from BM25 improve dense retriever training in low-data regimes.
A retrieval run file stores ranked document ids per query for metric computation.
